annotations.title: Pre/Post Context Compaction Information Retention Verifier

description: Audits a compacted conversation summary against the original full context to detect dropped user constraints, lost file paths, altered numbers, or missing pending tasks. Use when verifying that an LLM context-compaction summary retained all task-critical facts before truncating history; for generating a new executive summary from a raw technical document, use summarize_technical_document instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'original_context' ('compacted_summary' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

audit_focus.description: Entity class prioritized during retention scoring; defaults to 'constraints_paths_and_numbers' when omitted.

compacted_summary.description: Candidate compacted summary to audit for dropped constraints or entities.

original_context.description: Full pre-compaction conversation history or task log.

name: verify_context_compaction_fidelity

missing_critical_entities.description: Important entities or constraints dropped during compaction.

preserved_entities.description: Critical constraints, paths, and numbers verified present in the summary.

safe_to_resume.description: True when retention_score >= 0.90 and zero critical constraints were lost.

title: Pre/Post Context Compaction Information Retention Verifier
